Review Type: Adverse determination, level of care, inpatient versus observation

DETERMINATION

Cascade Mutual has completed a level of care review comparing the inpatient setting billed against the observation setting for the admission referenced above. Based on the records submitted, an adverse determination has been issued. The documentation available at the time of admission did not meet inpatient criteria.

CLAIM ADJUSTMENT CODING

CARC CO-50
RARC N130

CRITERIA APPLIED

Review was conducted using the MCG-style criteria set adopted by the plan for respiratory admissions. The following criteria codes were found not met:

COPD-01: Oxygenation was near baseline and did not require inpatient care.

COPD-02: Work of breathing was not significantly increased.

No other criteria codes were applied to this determination. This notice addresses the level of care only, inpatient versus observation, and is limited to that question.

APPEAL RIGHTS AND INSTRUCTIONS

You or your authorized representative may submit a written appeal of this level of care determination. Appeals must be addressed to Utilization Management at the address listed on the reverse of this notice.

A complete appeal submission should:

1. Reference the guideline code and the specific finding being disputed for each argument presented. Arguments submitted without reference to COPD-01 or COPD-02 and the corresponding finding may not be considered responsive.

2. Include any additional records from the admission that the submitter believes support the inpatient level of care.

3. Include a physician attestation line signed by the attending or treating physician.

Appeals must be received by [[APPEAL_DEADLINE]]. Submissions received after that date may be closed without substantive review.

A clinical peer reviewer who was not involved in this initial determination will conduct the appeal review. The member is not liable for charges denied under this determination except as permitted by the terms of the plan and applicable law.

Sincerely,

Medical Director, Utilization Management
Cascade Mutual
